pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Centre Attack, 7.Re1 b5 8.e5
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported the e5-pawn with d5 when White has no d-pawn and placed the bishop on b3 while it stands on a4. Rewrote plans 1-2 around 8...Nxe5 9.Rxe5 d6 10.Re1 bxa4 11.Nxd4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Centre Attack, 7.Re1 O-O
pages.notes: Overview called the Centre Attack the main line; plan 2 sent the f3-knight via d2 and f1. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2 around 8.e5 Ne8 and Nxd4 (first plan 2 rewrite rejected for a rook facing a bishop through the e4-pawn; corrected and accepted).

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight through the f1-rook. Rewrote it around d3, Nbd2 and the kingside majority. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.d3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the f3-knight through the f1-rook; plan 2's ...f5 and a knight on d4 were not the real ideas; plan 3 promised a winning pawn endgame. Rewrote plans 1-3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.d3 Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 named Nf1-g3 with no knight there and a g4 advance; plan 2 rerouted a knight from d7 with none there. Rewrote plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.d3 Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the b1-knight through the f1-rook. Rewrote it. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.d3 Nd7 8.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight through the f1-rook and planned f2-f4-f5 with the f3-knight in the way; plan 2's ...f5 replaced by the real ...f6. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.d3 Nd7 8.Nbd2 O-O 9.Nc4 f6 10.Nh4 Nc5 11.Nf5
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a g4-h5 route that cannot be played; plan 2's ...Ne6 after ...Bxf5 exf5 would lose the knight (first rewrite rejected); corrected and accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.Nc3 Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 targeted a c5-pawn that is not there. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.Qe1 c5
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight through the f1-rook; plan 2 called the d-file open; plan 3 proposed controlling c5, where Black's pawn stands. Rewrote plans 1-3. British spelling.
